simple.meaning: חׇזְקָה (chozqâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “vehemence (usually in a bad sense).” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 6 times in Judges, 1 Samuel, 2 Kings, Ezekiel, Jonah, beginning at Judges 4:3. The surrounding contexts include Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to חׇזְקָה (H2394) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: חׇזְקָה (chozqâh) / H2394 is traced through Judges 4:3, Judges 8:1, 1 Samuel 2:16, 2 Kings 12:13 with source-language evidence and verse context.

definitions.full: H2394. chozqah חָזְקָה noun feminine strength, force, violence , always בְּחָזְקָה with strength, force , etc.; — 1 of oppression Judg 4:3 forcibly, violently ; capture by force 1Sam 2:16 ; Ezek 34:4 of ruling ׳בְּח וּבְמָּ֑רֶךְ with force and with rigour. 2 rebuke severely, sharply Judg 8:1 ; cry mightily , insistently Jonah 3:8 . — לֲחָזְקָה 2Kin 12:13 see חָזַק Qal Infinitive

occurrences.englishText: The children of Israel cried to Yahweh, for he had nine hundred chariots of iron; and he mightily oppressed the children of Israel for twenty years.
The men of Ephraim said to him, “Why have you treated us this way, that you didn’t call us when you went to fight with Midian?” They rebuked him sharply.
If the man said to him, “Let the fat be burned first, and then take as much as your soul desires;” then he would say, “No, but you shall give it to me now; and if not, I will take it by force.”
But there were not made for Yahweh’s house cups of silver, snuffers, basins, trumpets, any vessels of gold, or vessels of silver, of the money that was brought into Yahweh’s house;

You haven’t strengthened the diseased. You haven’t healed that which was sick. You haven’t bound up that which was broken. You haven’t brought back that which was driven away. You haven’t sought that which was lost, but you have ruled over them with force and with rigor.
but let them be covered with sackcloth, both man and animal, and let them cry mightily to God. Yes, let them turn everyone from his evil way, and from the violence that is in his hands.
